capabilities: Copy inline code contents with one click
Choose icon style, position, and hover or permanent visibility
Exclude inline code from icons using regular-expression filters
Hide copy icons when printing or exporting to PDF
Show a success or failure notice after copying
disambiguation: Only copies inline code spans; it does not add copy buttons to fenced code blocks.
extras: Credits note the plugin is a maintained continuation of an original GPL v3.0 plugin, and it supports BRAT for beta installs.
intentEvidence: Copy Inline Code was originally created by Ondrej Zavodny. The plugin is now maintained by Vitovt.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to copy the contents of inline code without manually selecting the text.

relations.evidence: The plugin is now maintained by Vitovt. The original GNU General Public License v3.0 remains intact.
relations.plugin: Copy Inline Code (original by Ondrej Zavodny)

summary: Adds a configurable one-click copy icon to inline code spans in Live Preview and Reading mode.
